name: Get Last 3 Gmail Messages

steps.expression: const header = (m, n) => { const hs = (m.payload && m.payload.headers) || []; const h = hs.find((x) => x.name === n); return h ? h.value : undefined; }; return (input.scope.get_message.data || []).map((it) => it.get_message.data).map((m) => { const body = sk.emailBody(m); return { id: m.id, from: header(m, 'From'), subject: header(m, 'Subject'), date: header(m, 'Date'), snippet: m.snippet, body: body.text !== null ? body.text : body.html }; });

description: Fetch the last 3 Gmail messages with human-readable subject, sender, date, and snippet.
